reason: No tier-A item does a per-country crop-marker failure taxonomy under sparse labels across LPIS regimes. EuroCropsML's paper and its 2026 ISPRS follow-up stay leaderboard-style (MAML vs SSL vs transfer-learning %). AI4Boundaries' own paper only flags GSAA quality variation, no failure catalogue. Fields-of-the-World does 24-country zero-shot benchmarking but reports aggregate accuracy, not a failure taxonomy, and is global not LPIS-specific. A targeted LPIS/AMS cross-country query surfaced only single-country studies (Germany, Belgium).

prior_art.title: The EuroCropsML time series benchmark dataset for few-shot crop type classification in Europe
prior_art.why: Source dataset paper itself. Provides few-shot splits and a baseline transformer demo the authors explicitly call non-comprehensive; no per-country failure taxonomy or systematic error breakdown across LPIS regimes.

prior_art.title: Benchmarking for practice: Few-shot time-series crop-type classification on the EuroCropsML dataset
prior_art.why: Direct EuroCropsML follow-up (Estonia/Latvia/Portugal). Reports MAML beats transfer learning by ~31% on 20-shot tasks and notes cross-region transfer is hard, but stays leaderboard-style; no failure-mode catalogue or LPIS-regime breakdown.

prior_art.title: AI4Boundaries: an open AI-ready dataset to map field boundaries with Sentinel-2 and aerial photography
prior_art.why: Source dataset paper for field boundaries across 7 EU countries. Explicitly a data-description paper; limitations section flags GSAA label-quality variation across regions but builds no failure taxonomy.

prior_art.title: Fields of The World: A Machine Learning Benchmark Dataset for Global Agricultural Field Boundary Segmentation
prior_art.why: 24-country global field-boundary benchmark with zero-shot held-out-country evaluation, closest thing to cross-country generalization testing found. Reports aggregate accuracy metrics only, not a failure/error taxonomy, and is global scope, not EU/LPIS-specific.

prior_art.title: xFarm release notes: Spanish CAP cadastral fields and export updates
prior_art.why: Shipping CAP-compliance parcel-monitoring product. Operational dashboard/export tooling, not a published per-country failure-taxonomy analysis, so it does not close the research-framing claim.

nearest_neighbours_do_not: EuroCropsML/AI4Boundaries own papers do not evaluate failures at all, only describe datasets. The 2026 ISPRS follow-up and Fields-of-the-World both stress-test cross-region/cross-country generalization but report it as aggregate accuracy deltas, not a labelled failure taxonomy tied to national LPIS label regimes.
